title: FX3 7.02: rear screen shows the open-gate live view at 3:2 (16:9 letterbox ratio 9/16 -> 2/3, frame widgets' 16:9 entries for both panel shapes), and the built-in Anamorphic Desqueeze display ratios set for a 3:2 picture (1.3x 1.95:1, 1.5x 2.25:1, 1.65x 2.475:1, 2.0x the whole frame at 3:1)
artifact: cpapp-b.bin 7.02 (ILME-FX3), its loaded image in coprocessor RAM: the words are in the file, the change is made in RAM only
ported_from: lcdratio32_s3_v1 (A7S III 5.01; works on that camera, ninth test 2026-11-22): the same 2/3 ratio and frame entries, in the A7 IV's instruction form; the de-squeeze part is new (the A7S III kit has a C3 routine instead)

summary.picture: 16:9 live view (aspect code 2) holding the whole 3:2 sensor area

while_applied: every 16:9 picture on the rear screen is shown at 3:2 and the de-squeeze ratios are those of a 3:2 picture (other movie formats look wrong there). 2.0x's ratio is the calculator's default for every picture shape and its crop is off for every shape, so 2.0x shows any picture at 3:1 (the open-gate live view is always 16:9). HDMI's own layout (0x1dfb18) and the 17:9 ratios of 1.3x / 1.5x / 1.65x are unchanged
not_checked: on a camera: nothing of this design has run on an FX3
the FX3's panel type byte 0x14909e4 (expected 2 = 4:3; the dump reads it)
that the FX3's menu sends codes 1 to 4 for 1.3x, 1.5x, 1.65x and 2.0x (inferred from the ratios)
whether the focus frames are drawn while de-squeeze is on (the frame check has no de-squeeze input; stock behaves the same)
